policy: Preserve every raw S/R row. Same-day R/S has no global priority. Equal timing endpoints are not proof of zero-duration or full-day suspension.

reviewed_cases.semantic_finding: Continued-suspension notice retrospectively describes suspension from 2025-11-03 and inability to resume on 2025-11-05; supports intervening 2025-11-04 suspension
reviewed_cases.scope_limit: Retrospective interval inference, not a precise receipt before target date; expected further three days does not establish actual resumption

reviewed_cases.semantic_finding: Issuer explicitly confirms suspension on 2026-01-14 and 2026-01-15
reviewed_cases.scope_limit: Retrospective evidence received after target date is not a historical prediction input

reviewed_cases.semantic_finding: Issuer explicitly continues suspension for one day on 2026-01-16; equal provider endpoints do not establish zero duration
reviewed_cases.scope_limit: Same-date publication is not exact historical ingestion time; no later resume date inferred

reviewed_cases.semantic_finding: Issuer retrospectively confirms 2026-06-15 and 2026-06-16 suspension before continued suspension from June 17
reviewed_cases.scope_limit: June 23 publication cannot be a June 16 historical prediction input; announced June 23 resumption does not prove fills

reviewed_cases.semantic_finding: Issuer explicitly continues suspension for one full trading day from July 6 open and announces July 7 open resumption
reviewed_cases.scope_limit: No historical receipt or actual July 7 fill proven; stock-specific risk-warning and limit statements are not generalized

reviewed_cases.semantic_finding: Issuer explicitly says planned 2026-01-12 resumption cannot occur and suspension continues that day
reviewed_cases.scope_limit: Expected two further trading days is not a confirmed resume time; earlier 2026-01-09 halt began midday, not a full-day halt

reviewed_cases.semantic_finding: Issuer table explicitly identifies full-day suspension on 2026-01-13, continuing suspension begun 2026-01-12
reviewed_cases.scope_limit: Publication date is not an exact prior-to-open receipt; expected total two days does not prove resumption

reviewed_cases.semantic_finding: Issuer states suspension from market open 2026-01-22 for planned major asset restructuring
reviewed_cases.scope_limit: Expected nine-day maximum is not actual resume timestamp; does not authorize forecasting use before observed source availability

reviewed_cases.semantic_finding: Issuer explicitly resumes trading on 2025-06-10, first delisting-period trading day; full-day suspension interpretation is contradicted
reviewed_cases.scope_limit: Does not establish intraday no-halt status or actual fill. First delisting-period day has no price limit per this notice, not a rule for other dates/stocks.

reviewed_cases.semantic_finding: Issuer states suspension from market open on 2025-11-26 for planned asset acquisition; equal endpoints must not be treated as a verified zero-length trading interruption
reviewed_cases.scope_limit: Expected no-more-than-ten trading days is not verified resumption date. Publication date is not precise historical ingestion time.
